C0111.title: Henan Yuzhou Court Sentences Defendant in Livestream Traffic Fraud Case
C0111.summary: In May 2026, the case was reported and selected as a typical judicial consumer-protection case. Yuzhou Court in Henan ruled on a livestream traffic-farming case in which defendant Wang organized fake traffic inflation in livestream rooms and was convicted of illegal business operations, receiving a sentence of five years and three months plus an 80,000-yuan fine. The conduct used false traffic to raise livestream exposure, induce impulsive consumer purchases, and undermine fair market competition.
